desc: Keep the same character, colors, face, outline and details. Redraw as a low wide creature composition about 79 pixels wide and 70 tall: a big head at the upper right with the face mostly front-facing and turned only slightly right, the body low and horizontal toward the lower left, short legs at the bottom, a cloak or tail curling out to the left. Feathered wings folded up behind the body, short gold spear lying along the body, no halo. 1px outline, flat shades. Transparent background.
